description: Assemble a bounded village asset pack end-to-end with deterministic exports and pack-level evidence
deviation_notes: Prerequisite: rigid_animation_sprite_pipeline_20260717 (and transitively the three upstream authoring tracks) must complete before implementation begins.

sprint.goal: Let an LLM assemble, validate, and export one coherent game-ready village starter pack — characters, equipment, props, vegetation, and structures — as versioned documents, sprite sheets, atlases, and GLBs under a single digested pack manifest.
